verdict.rationale: The README documents starting the local OpenAI-compatible server from the command line with `edge0 serve edge0-35b`, which then accepts requests at 127.0.0.1:8000. The macOS build is described as a local CLI/daemon. Stopping is only implied by running the server as a foreground process, not documented. Missing for 10: explicit stop/daemon-management commands (stop/status/restart), configuration of host/port, and independent hands-on corroboration.
